expect_red: under file:// the study's respine transition settles too, before any of its rows are addressed

mutations.contract: The file:// half of the annotate-flyout suite waits out the study's respine before it addresses a row, and a pane that never settles fails there BY NAME and stops the half -- it does not reach the `tr.tvrow` click and abort the suite as an unnamed ERROR.
mutations.note: Scoped to file:// on purpose. The mounted half's own spec (`var settling = false`) never settles under either origin, so it reddens the mounted half first and says nothing about this one; this mutation leaves the served page settling and makes only the file:// page's transition permanent, which is the case this half's push exists for.
